instruction: 走到左侧小桌并抓取桌上的香蕉模型，拿着它走到右侧小桌，并将香蕉模型放进篮子。

stages.name: 走向左桌
stages.completion_evidence: 到达可抓取香蕉的位置

stages.name: 抓取香蕉
stages.completion_evidence: 香蕉离开桌面并由机器人持有

stages.name: 持物走向右桌
stages.completion_evidence: 保持持物，到达右桌篮子附近

stages.name: 放入篮子
stages.completion_evidence: 香蕉释放并留在篮子内

annotation_policy.occluded_or_ambiguous_events: unknown; do not convert to failure or success
annotation_policy.evaluation_unit: whole recording; frames from one recording never cross train/validation/test
annotation_policy.main_limit: One recording session with only one operator-marked failure; cannot estimate general failure detection from this alone

original_mcap_and_human_reviews: Keep original records unchanged; store research annotations separately
